Actor James Marsden, who earlier played billionaire Owen Ashe in the second season of "Your Friends & Neighbors," has this week confirmed his third Apple TV project. Here's what we know.

Apple TV is developing a new mystery comedy

Apple Studios previously confirmed that James Marsden ("Paradise," "X-Men: Days of Future Past") will play CIA field officer Brad Griffin in the upcoming thriller "Disavowed."

The news comes just weeks before the premiere of the second season of "Your Friends & Neighbors," in which he plays billionaire Owen Ashe.

According to Deadline (citing MacMagazine), Marsden has confirmed his third Apple TV project, this time a mystery comedy titled "Bad News Dads."

Here's the Deadline report:

Like "Disavowed," Marsden will also serve as executive producer. Deadline added that the series is created by Stephen Falk, the creator of "You're the Worst."

The report noted that Frost's original novel "Bad News Dads" is scheduled for publication on April 6, 2027, and the half-hour Apple TV mystery comedy adaptation is still in development, with a premiere date yet to be announced.

To read Deadline's full report, go here.

Apple TV costs $12.99 per month, or is available as part of an Apple One bundle. The platform offers many popular series and films, including "Severance," "The Studio," "The Morning Show," "Shrinking," and "Silo."
